planets.name: TOI-628 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-628 with a 3.41-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-628 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-628. Its orbit and size follow Rodriguez et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname RODRIGUEZ_ET_AL__2021): disc_year 2021, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.4095675, pl_radj 1.06, pl_bmassj 6.33

quotes.title: TOI-628 b
quotes.card: TOI-628 b is an exoplanet whose mass is 6.33 times that of Jupiter.
quotes.introduction: It has an orbital period of 3.4 days and was discovered by TESS in January 2021.
